userStories.title: Specification, error-naming, and iterative-refinement signals
acceptanceCriteria: BehavioralSignals gains specification_artifact_count, error_naming_count, iterative_refinement_count fields (int, default 0); existing fields untouched.
Each signal has a regex (or set of regexes) in signals.py with cite comments to its primary source from Section 14, and is wired into extract_signals so it fires on a per-session transcript.
For each signal, tests/behavior/fixtures/ holds 5 positive and 5 negative session fixtures; the test asserts the positive fixtures produce count >= 1 and the negative fixtures produce count == 0.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Knowledge-gap four-subtype classifier
acceptanceCriteria: BehavioralSignals gains knowledge_gaps: dict[str,int] with keys missing_context, missing_specs, multiple_context, unclear_instructions, each counted per user-turn and summed per session.
A per-turn classifier in signals.py assigns at most one category per turn (with a documented precedence order) and writes 0 for all keys when no gap detected.
A fixture with a turn matching two categories produces only the higher-precedence key incremented (not both), so totals match the precedence rule and not double-counts.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Plan mode, scaffolding, TDD, recipe, context-and-instructions signals
acceptanceCriteria: BehavioralSignals gains plan_mode_count, scaffolding_artifact_count, tdd_marker_count, recipe_pattern_count, context_instructions_count fields with patterns drawn from Anthropic Claude Code best practices, OpenAI Codex docs, and arXiv 2506.01604.
Each pattern has 5+5 fixtures under tests/behavior/fixtures/; fixtures are stable across re-runs.
A blank or whitespace-only transcript yields 0 for every new field (no false positives on empty input).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Verification-depth, code-comprehension, tool-ladder signals
acceptanceCriteria: BehavioralSignals gains verification_depth: dict[str,int] with keys source_check, test_run, spot_check, blanket_accept; plus code_comprehension_count and tool_ladder_level (int 0..4 for prompt-only/tools-on/skills/hooks/subagents) fields.
tool_ladder_level for a session is the max ladder rung observed in that session's transcript; ladder rules are documented in signals.py with cite comments.
A session that mixes a tool call and a hook reference resolves to ladder_level = max(2, 3) = 3, not the sum, and that case is covered by a test.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest
